question.prompt: A bug crawls along a number line, starting at \(-2.\) It crawls to \(-6,\) then turns around and crawls to \(5.\) How many units does the bug crawl altogether?

solutions.explanation:
Add the lengths of both parts of the journey. Each length is the absolute value of the change in position, so the total distance is
\[
|-6-(-2)|+|5-(-6)|
=4+11=\boxed{15}
\]
units. The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
solutions.title: Add the two travel distances
